scope.target: Saudi-market buyer with unbuilt core software product and no more than two software builders including hands-on cofounders
scope.sources: Public web search, publicly visible LinkedIn original posts/jobs and first-party websites. Signed-in browser operated only by root.
restrictions: No collection of telephone, email or private identifiers.
No inference that profile silence or company headcount proves a software-team upper bound.

summary.shortfall: The bounded public search did not establish five fresh, fully qualified Saudi pre-build paid buyers. Four core research holds remain, two with clearer contract/request language; none passes all identity, authority, Saudi, current-product and team gates.

method_notes: Approximately forty Arabic and English queries were explored; this is not a reproducible count of all unique search hits and must not be used as a source-yield denominator.
Preserve literal displayed relative dates because cached public pages sometimes disagree; observation today does not refresh a stale request.
Requests to hire or offer equity indicate a build problem but not willingness to purchase an agency service.
Suppliers recommending themselves in replies are not buyers; a repost author is not the original requester.
Saudi developer preference, sa.linkedin.com/ae.linkedin.com URL locale, and a generic Gulf label are not independently sufficient Saudi-project proof.
No automated profile traversal or form submission was used.

reusable_discovery_examples.name: Lovable Founder Series at COLABS Narjis
reusable_discovery_examples.author: Mira Charkawi
reusable_discovery_examples.description: Event invitation explicitly addresses people with an idea waiting for a technical cofounder. Potential pre-build discovery channel, not a list of qualified buyers.
reusable_discovery_examples.harvesting_instruction: Use future organizer posts and public participant-authored project descriptions to discover named ventures, then verify actual software needs and team bounds. Attendance/comments alone do not qualify.
reusable_discovery_examples.limitation: No upcoming session or paid-development intent verified; relative date and event date should be rechecked.

actionable_queries.intent: Find explicit small-institution mobile-build project requests.
Find request authors and distinguish project buyers from recruiters.
Use request verbs; then eliminate equity, supplier marketing and existing-MVP posts.
Find English first-person commercial buying posts; much supplier noise remains.
Find direct supplier procurement, with strict company-size/team filters afterwards.

suggested_followup_order: Mo'men: institution identity, present completion and authority.
SOKAINH: commissioning venture/authority, present product state and eligibility for a non-Saudi agency.
Do not allocate equal verification time to stale equity requests or website-only/enterprise scope examples.
Prefer 30-day original buyer posts, with a separate stale/reference queue and explicit paid-versus-equity classification.
